The main takeaway from our work is that

measles virus (MV), a human pathogen, uses a C-type lectin receptor called DC-SIGN to subvert the RIG-I like receptor (RLR) signaling pathway in dendritic cells (DC), which leads to the inhibition of RIG-I and MDAS activation and type I interferon responses.
the C-type lectins DC-SIGN and DC-SIGNR are critical regulators of the innate immune system and can be targeted for therapeutic intervention.
